text:
Maya (CS): Hey team — I uploaded a trimmed evidence bundle for Aurora Health (DPA + SOC2 overlap). Need quick QA on scope and redactions before we hand it to the customer. Link: https://files.redwood.internal/evidence/aurora_slim_2026-03-21.zip
Priya (Onboard): Thanks Maya. Can you paste the list of files in the bundle so I can confirm along with the onboarding checklist?
Maya (CS): Sure — top-level: dpa_statement.pdf, soc2_sample_list.csv, embeddings-retention.md, kms_key_list.csv, nonprod_flags.txt, logs-sample-redacted.json
Nina (Legal): Quick note: if embeddings-retention.md asserts an exception, we need a documented business justification and expiry date. Also confirm whether any PHI could be present in nonprod artifacts.
Oscar (Security): Also need KMS key provenance. If keys are customer BYOK, flag that in kms_key_list.csv. If we used RW-managed keys, add the key rotation evidence.
Kyle (Eng): I can run the redaction script on logs-sample. Use this snippet:
```
# redact PII
python tools/redact.py --input logs-sample.json --output logs-sample-redacted.json --rules rules/pii.yaml
```
Kyle (Eng): After redaction I will checksum the file and add sha256 in soc2_sample_list.csv column 'hash'
Sam (CS): Timing concern — Aurora's renewal review is next Tue. If legal needs extra justification, flag as renewal risk and I'll push a proactive cover note with the customer.
Maya (CS): Noted. Nina — current justification draft in embeddings-retention.md says: "short-term analytic cache used for latency testing; TTL set to 30 days; no PHI intentionally stored". We can add expiry date and owner.
Nina (Legal): Works as a start. Add owner (Priya or Sam) and set expiry calendar date + process to purge. I need a single-line statement we can include in DPA appendix.
Priya (Onboard): I'll take ownership of purge process and set expiry to 2026-04-21. Updating the doc now.
Oscar (Security): One more ask — confirm that nonprod_flags.txt lists environments with sanitized data only. If not, mark nonprod as containing limited production subsets and note compensating controls.
Maya (CS): Confirmed — nonprod_flags.txt currently: "dev: synthetic; staging: limited-prod-subset (sanitized); perf-test: ephemeral". I'll update staging to include the compensating controls per Oscar.
evidence-bot: Uploaded aurora_slim_2026-03-21.zip (34 MB) to /evidence/aurora/2026-03-21/ — sha256: a3b5...c9f1
Kyle (Eng): Redaction run complete, updated logs-sample-redacted.json and appended sha256 to soc2_sample_list.csv
Maya (CS): Ok — I've added Nina's one-line DPA appendix statement and Priya's purge date. Updated kms_key_list.csv to mark RW-managed keys and attached rotation proof.
Nina (Legal): I reviewed the one-liner and purge date. Approve to send to customer once Oscar signs off on the compensating controls wording.
Oscar (Security): I added a short paragraph to nonprod_flags.txt describing the compensating controls (access logs, ephemeral creds, restricted subnet). Approve from security side.
Sam (CS): I'll send the bundle with a short cover note highlighting the purge date and controls, and call out the renewal timeline to procurement.
Maya (CS): Thanks everyone — I'll schedule a 15-min sync if anything pops up. :thumbsup:
_meta: generated for dataset. single-thread slack style conversation about DPA/SOC2 evidence bundle and onboarding/renewal coordination
